en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ja’far Bin Sama’at, and Ali Bin Khalid Al Aqouly, from Karram, from Muhammad Bin Muslim,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> – similar to it’.

Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, form Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the pregnant woman widowed from her husband, are there expenses for her?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu al-Sabbah al-Kinaniy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a pregnant widow if she has the right for maintenance.
He (the Imam) said, ’No, she does not have such right.’”
